2607.14275.title: AI Agents Do Not Fail Alone:The Context Fails First
2607.14275.paper_summary: Context engineering has become central to building reliable AI agents, yet it remains largely unmeasured. Agents do not fail in isolation: their behavior is shaped by the instructions, tools, memory, retrieved knowledge, guardrails, and untrusted inputs accumulated in their context. When this context is weak, agents drift, hallucinate, misuse tools, ignore constraints, become vulnerable to injection, and waste tokens. This paper validates context-engineering quality as an independent leading indicator of agent reliability. We implement the measurement in ProofAgent-Harness, an open-source infrastructure for AI agent evaluation that uses multi-juror, consensus-based scoring. The harness assesses context across seven criteria: role clarity, guardrail coverage, instruction consistency, tool schema quality, grounding sufficiency, injection hardening, and token efficiency. Crucially, the context score is isolated from behavioral metrics and release decisions, enabling a non-circular validation. Through a controlled context-quality study across regulated agent domains, holding frontier LLM agents fixed and varying only their operating context, we show that context-quality criteria consistently predict their corresponding behavioral outcomes. Grounding sufficiency predicts hallucination resistance, guardrail coverage predicts manipulation resistance, instruction consistency predicts instruction following, and tool-schema quality predicts tool use. These findings establish context measurement as a validated preflight signal for agent reliability and position context engineering as an auditable layer of agent evaluation and governance.
2607.14275.paper_summary_zh: 上下文工程已成為構建可靠 AI 代理的核心，但其仍然在很大程度上未被測量。代理並不是孤立失敗的：它們的行為受到指令、工具、記憶、檢索知識、護欄和在其上下文中累積的不可信輸入的影響。當這個上下文薄弱時，代理會漂移、產生幻覺、誤用工具、忽視約束、變得易受注入攻擊，並浪費代幣。本文驗證了上下文工程質量作為代理可靠性的獨立領先指標。我們在 ProofAgent-Harness 中實施了這一測量，這是一個開源的 AI 代理評估基礎設施，使用多陪審員、基於共識的評分。該工具在七個標準上評估上下文：角色清晰度、護欄覆蓋率、指令一致性、工具架構質量、基礎充分性、注入加固和代幣效率。關鍵是，上下文得分與行為指標和發布決策相互獨立，從而實現非循環驗證。通過在受管制的代理領域進行的控制上下文質量研究，固定前沿 LLM 代理並僅變化其操作上下文，我們顯示上下文質量標準一致地預測其相應的行為結果。基礎充分性預測幻覺抵抗，護欄覆蓋率預測操控抵抗，指令一致性預測指令遵循，而工具架構質量預測工具使用。這些發現確立了上下文測量作為代理可靠性的驗證前信號，並將上下文工程定位為代理評估和治理的一個可審計層。
